seo.title: Our Story – A Tradition With Deep Roots
seo.description: How The CaneHouse brings the tradition of fresh sugarcane juice to Sutton, London and beyond. Meet the people, the press and the promise behind every glass.

sections.title: More Than Just A Drink
text: Before supermarkets. Before energy drinks. Before everything became instant – there was sugarcane juice.
Freshly pressed. Shared with friends. Enjoyed together under the summer sun.
The CaneHouse brings that timeless tradition to Sutton and beyond. We source the finest sugarcane, press it fresh while you watch and serve it with love.
